'''2000 Arizona State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Arizona on 25 March 2000. [[DJ Andrews]] won it. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d396">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-az-states-who-gets-mized-worse-thand396/ az-states-who-gets-mized-worse-than], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 27 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-az-states-who-gets-mized-worse-thand396/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[DJ Andrews]]
